900.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
The fire runs away from the fuel.

900.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ; ਜਲੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
900.e: The water runs away from the dust in all directions.
The feet are above, and the sky is beneath.
The ocean appears in the cup. ||1||
Such is our all-powerful dear Lord.

900.g: ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
900.e: His devotees do not forget Him, even for an instant. Twenty-four hours a day, O mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||
First comes the butter, and then the milk.
The dirt cleans the soap.
The fearless are afraid of fear.
The living are killed by the dead. ||2||
The visible body is hidden, and the etheric body is seen.
The Lord of the world does all these things.
The one who is cheated, is not cheated by the cheat.

900.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
900.e: With no merchandise, the trader trades again and again. ||3||
So join the Society of the Saints, and chant the Lord's Name.
So say the Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas.
Rare are those who contemplate and meditate on God.

900.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੪॥
900.e: O Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||43||54||
Whose name was Ghar-jawai; she served him dainty foods.(4)
Chaupaee
Raja appeared when they were making love.
Rani was very much anguished.

900.g: ਯਾ ਕੋ ਦਯਾ, ਕਹੌ ਕਾ ਕਰਿਹੌ ॥
900.e: (She thought,) ‘What should I do about him.

900.g: ਯਾ ਕੇ ਹਨੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਹੌ ਮਰਿਹੌ ॥੪॥
900.e: Should I kill him and then terminate my life.’( 4)
Dohira

900.g: ਧਰਿ ਖੋਪਰ ਸਿਰ ਪਰ ਨਦੀ; ਤਰਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਡਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
900.e: With shell on the head, he went across swimming.
Dohira

900.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਪੁਰੀ ਭੀਤਰ ਹੁਤੋ; ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੈਨ ਇਕ ਰਾਵ ॥
900.e: In Chandra Puri there lived a Raja, called Chandra Sen.

900.g: ਬਲ ਗੁਨ ਬੀਰਜ ਮੈ ਜਨੁਕ; ਤ੍ਰਿਦਸੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਵ ॥੧॥
900.e: In power and intelligence he was embodiment of Lord Indra.(1)

900.g: ਭਾਗਵਤੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
900.e: His wife, Bhagwati, was bestowed with extreme beauty,

900.g: ਰਤਿ ਰਤਿਨਾਥ ਪਛਾਨਿ ਤਿਹ; ਝੁਕਿ ਝੁਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੁਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
900.e: Whom, even, the Cupid would bow to pay his obeisance.(2)

900.g: ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹੁਤੋ; ਰਾਨੀ ਲਯੋ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
900.e: Once the Rani invited a very Handsome man,

900.g: ਭੋਗ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਯੋ; ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਖ ਉਪਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
900.e: She made love with him to her full satisfaction of her heart.(3)
Then the paramour narrated, ‘Rani, don’t worry about me.

900.g: ਯਾ ਕੀ ਗਰੀ ਭਛ ਕਰ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
900.e: ‘Give this melon to me after eating its pulp yourself.’(5)
Rani complied and after cutting it let him eat the melon.

900.g: ਲੈ ਖੋਪਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰ ਪੈ ਧਰਿਯੋ ॥

900.e: Then she replaced the shell on his head and made a whole at the top for breathing.( 6)
Chaupaee
She cried, ‘Live-in son-in-law has run away with my daughter.

900.g: ਮੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਸੋਧ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੭॥
900.e: ‘The Sun has set, but he has not come back. I have no news of them.’(7)
When the Quazi (the justice) and the policeman heard this, they both, laughingly, shook their heads.

900.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੈ ਦਯੋ ॥
ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ, ਜੌ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਲੈ ਗਯੋ ॥੮॥
900.e: ‘When you have married your daughter to him, then what if he has taken her to his house.’(8)

900.g: ਭੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਕਛੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਜਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥
900.e: Everybody branded her as a liar without understanding the secret.

900.g: ਲੂਟਿ ਦਰਬੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਭ ਲਯੋ ॥

900.e: Rather she was plundered and banished from the country.(9)(1)

900.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਛਿਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੬॥੧੩੧੦॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
900.e: Seventy-sixth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (76)(1308)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Such is the Perfect Divine Guru, my help and support.

900.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
900.e: Meditation on Him is not wasted. ||1||Pause||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured.

900.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
900.e: The dust of His feet snaps the noose of Death.

900.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੇ ॥
900.e: His lotus feet dwell within my mind,
and so all the affairs of my body are arranged and resolved. ||1||
One upon whom He places His Hand, is protected.
My God is the Master of the masterless.
He is the Savior of sinners, the treasure of mercy.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
One whom He blesses with His Immaculate Mantra,
renounces corruption; his egotistical pride is dispelled.
Meditate on the One Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Sins are erased, through the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
The Guru, the Transcendent Lord, dwells among all.
The treasure of virtue pervades and permeates each and every heart.
Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan;
O God, I place my hopes in You. Nanak continually offers this true prayer. ||4||45||56||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Whatever pleases Him happens.

900.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਆਨ ਬੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
900.e: Forever and ever, I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.There is none other than God. ||1||Pause||

900.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਦੀਸੈ; ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
900.e: You look upon your children, spouse and wealth; none of these will go along with you.

900.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
900.e: Eating the poisonous potion, you have gone astray. You will have to go, and leave Maya and your mansions. ||1||

900.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
900.e: Slandering others, you are totally ruined; because of your past actions, you shall be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.

900.g: ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਣੇ. ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਮਦੂਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੨॥
900.e: Your past actions will not just go away; the most horrible Messenger of Death shall seize you. ||2||

900.g: ਬੋਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਵਰਾ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਇਆ ॥
900.e: You tell lies, and do not practice what you preach. Your desires are not satisfied - what a shame.

900.g: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ. ਸੰਤ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਖਇਆ ॥੩॥
900.e: You have contracted an incurable disease; slandering the Saints, your body is wasting away; you are utterly ruined. ||3||

900.g: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੇ; ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਇਆ ॥
900.e: He embellishes those whom He has fashioned. He Himself gave life to the Saints.

900.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੪॥੫੫॥
900.e: O Nanak, He hugs His slaves close in His Embrace. Please grant Your Grace, O Supreme Lord God, and be kind to me as well. ||4||44||55||
Chaupaee

900.g: ਵਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਨਿਚੀਤੀ ॥
900.e: A year had gone by when she felt relieved of all her tribulations.

900.g: ਵਹ ਤਿਹ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥

900.e: The thief used to perform her all the domestic errands, and she never worried for any thing.(5)
Dohira

900.g: ਕੇਤਿਕ ਦਿਨ ਤਹ ਚਲਿ ਗਯੋ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਤਾ ਚੁਰਾਇ ॥
900.e: After some time he trammeled her daughter and took her away.

900.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਰੋਵਤ ਕੁਟਵਾਰ ਕੇ; ਤਟ ਚਟ ਕੂਕੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
900.e: Crying and wailing she went to the city policeman.(6)

901.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.

901.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ. ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,
and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||
In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.
O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

901.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
901.e: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.

901.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.e: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||

901.g: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
901.e: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.

901.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ; ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
901.e: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1||
Chaupaee
The carpenter, named Sumat asked one day, ‘Gigo (the wife), listen what I have to say.
I am going abroad, and will come back after earning lot of money.’(2)
Saying so, presumably he went abroad, but, as a matter of fact, he hid himself under the bed.
Then lady-carpenter called her paramour and revelled in making love with him.(3)
While having sex-play, she discovered her husband lying under the bed.

901.g: ਚਿਤ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਈ ॥੪॥
901.e: Her whole body started to ache and felt much remorse at heart.(4)

901.g: ਤਬ ਤਾ ਸੌ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਬਚਨ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥
ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤ, ਦਈ ਕੇ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
901.e: Then the woman said to her lover, ‘Oh, my Lord what are you doing.

901.g: ਹੌ ਜਿਹ ਬਸਤ ਬਾਹ ਕੀ ਛਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
901.e: ‘My Master is not at home; only under his protection I can outlive.(5)
Chaupaee
Then Rani spoke, ‘Listen my master, we are very lucky,

901.g: ਬੂਡਿ ਕੋਊ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਤ ਮਰੈ ॥

901.e: ‘No one should lay his life for this, otherwise a curse will remain in my conscious.’(10)
Dohira

901.g: ਏਕ ਤਖਾਨ ਉਜੈਨ ਮੈ; ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
901.e: There lived a carpenter in Ujain, whose wife conducted a vile Chritar.

901.g: ਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ; ਸੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਹੌ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
901.e: Now I am going to narrated you that with a few amends.(1)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.

901.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled. ||1||Pause||
Worship and adore that One Lord alone.

901.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
901.e: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||

901.g: ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
901.e: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||
Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.
The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||

901.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
901.e: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.
O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58||
Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.

901.g: ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ; ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.e: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth and the sky. ||1||Pause||
Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.
He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||

901.g: ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ; ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
901.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exalted and infinite.

901.g: ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ. ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
901.e: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59||
Dohira

901.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਹਿਤ ਹਿਦਵਾਨ ਕੇ; ਮਨੁਖ ਬੁਰਾਯੋ ਏਕ ॥
901.e: Rani had assigned one person in connection with (saving) the melon, (Who interceded,)

901.g: ਯਹ ਅਪਜਸ ਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਮਿਟੈ; ਭਾਖਹਿ ਲੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧੧॥
901.e: ‘Every body was expressing if it happens as such (that man is killed), then, this blot will ever be remembered.’(11)
Dohira

901.g: ਨਿਤਿ ਅੰਸੂਆ ਆਖਿਨ ਭਰੌਂ ਰਹੋਂ ਮਲੀਨੇ ਭੇਸ ॥
901.e: ‘With tears in my eyes, I always remain in menial dress.

901.g: ਪੌਰ ਲਗੇ ਬਿਹਰੌ ਨਹੀਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਪਰਦੇਸ ॥੬॥
901.e: My master being gone abroad, I never take a step out side the house.(6)

901.g: ਲਗਤ ਬੀਰਿਯਾ ਬਾਨ ਸੀ; ਬਿਖੁ ਸੋ ਲਗਤ ਅਨਾਜ ॥
901.e: ‘Beetle-leaves and bird (cigarettes) hit me like the arrows, and the food

901.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਪਰਦੇਸ ਗੇ; ਤਾ ਬਿਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਜ ॥੭॥
901.e: When husband is abroad, nothing savours me.(7)

901.g: ਬਾਢੀ ਐਸੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ; ਮਨ ਮੈ ਭਯੋ ਖੁਸਾਲ ॥
901.e: Listening to such praise, he (the husband) was much pleased,

901.g: ਜਾਰ ਸਹਿਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਖਾਟ ਲੈ; ਨਾਚਿ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥੮॥
901.e: And carrying the bed on his head he started to dance.(8)(1)

901.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਅਠਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੮॥੧੩੩੦॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
901.e: Seventy-eighth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (78)(1328)
Chaupaee
She, herself, had floated the melon, herself, infuriated Raja,
And, herself, she called various people.
No one can understand the Chritars of the woman.(12)(1)

901.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਸਤਤਹਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੭॥੧੩੨੨॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
901.e: Seventy-seventh Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (77)(1320)

901.g: ਦਿਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਯੋ; ਭੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਕੋਇ ॥੭॥
901.e: People kept on watching but could not fathom.(7)

901.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਸੁਨਿਯੈ ਬਚਨ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
901.e: Then Rani said (to Raja), ‘Please listen to me,

901.g: ਬਹਤ ਜਾਤ ਤਰਬੂਜ ਜੋ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਹਾਲ ॥੮॥
901.e: ‘The melon, which is floating, is needed by me.’(8)

901.g: ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਤਬੈ; ਪਠਏ ਮਨੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
901.e: Conceding (to her request), Raja despatched a few men.

901.g: ਜਾਤ ਬਹੇ ਤਰਬੂਜ ਕੌ; ਪਹੁਚਤ ਭਯੋ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੯॥
901.e: They all ran fast but could not catch the melon drifting across.(9)
Dohira
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

901.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ, ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ. ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.e: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled by gold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||

901.g: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ; ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
901.e: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfort your mind,
but these will not go along with you. ||1||

901.g: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ, ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ; ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
901.e: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled; these pass like the shadow of a tree.

901.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
901.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of the Saints. ||2||2||60||

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
902.e: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

902.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
902.e: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.

902.g: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.e: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ; ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
902.e: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.

902.g: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ. ਸਮਝੈ; ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
902.e: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness in which you are entangled. ||1||

902.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ; ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
902.e: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?

902.g: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ. ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ; ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
902.e: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||2||

902.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
902.e: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.

902.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ. ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
902.e: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires, who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81||

902.g: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ. ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
902.e: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;

902.g: ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ; ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
902.e: that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant. ||2||

902.g: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ. ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ. ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
902.e: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has he performed?

902.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
902.e: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1||

902.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
902.e: Dohira

902.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹੈ; ਛੋਰਿ ਧਾਮ ਕੋ ਕਾਮ ॥
902.e: Abandoning all the household work, she would always recount, ‘Krishna. Krishna.’

902.g: ਨਿਸਦਿਨ ਰਟਤ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਜ︀ਯੋ ਜਗਨਾਯਕ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੪॥
902.e: And, day in and day out, she would repeat his name like a parrot.(4)

902.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
902.e: Dohira

902.g: ਮੁਰਜ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੁਤੋ; ਸੋ ਆਯੋ ਇਹ ਧਾਮ ॥
902.e: ‘Murj Nath Jogi had come to our house,

902.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੋਗ ਮੋ ਸੌ ਕਿਯੌ; ਸੁਤ ਦੀਨੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਮ ॥੬॥
902.e: ‘He made love with me through vision and gave me this child.(6)

902.g: ਬਨਿਕ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਚੁਪ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਭਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ︀ਯ ॥
902.e: The Shah, after learning this, was satisfied and shut himself.

902.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੋਗ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਿਯੌ ਧਰਨੀ ਤਲ ਸੋ ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ॥੭॥
902.e: He commended the yogi who had endowed the boy through the vision.(7)(1)

902.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਉਨਾਸੀਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੯॥੧੩੩੭॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
902.e: Seventy-ninth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction.(79)(1335)

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
902.e: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

902.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
902.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

902.g: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
902.e: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.

902.g: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ. ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ; ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ. ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
902.e: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||

902.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
902.e: Give up your attachment to life.

902.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ; ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.e: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ. ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
902.e: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at any sacred shrine.

902.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ. ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
902.e: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion he has built. ||2||

902.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ, ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ; ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ, ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
902.e: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home of the sincere.

902.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ. ਬਦਨਾਵੀ; ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
902.e: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||

902.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ; ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
902.e: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,

902.g: ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ; ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
902.e: when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4||

902.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
902.e: Chaupaee

902.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਪਿਤੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
902.e: She never cared about her mother or father, and went on reciting, ‘Krishna, Krishna.’

902.g: ਹੇਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਨੰਦ ਜਸੋਮਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਲਜਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
902.e: She would go every day to see him, but she blushed on seeing Nand and Yashoda.(5)

902.g: ਬਨਿਕ ਏਕ ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ; ਬਿਸਨ ਦਤ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮ ॥
902.e: The name of a Shah of Benares was Bishan Datt.

902.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਮਤੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ; ਧਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
902.e: He had lot of wealth; Bisva Mati was his wife.(1)

902.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
902.e: Chaupaee

902.g: ਸਭ ਗੋਪੀ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
ਨਿਤਿਯ ਕਿਸਨ ਕਹ ਸੀਸ ਝੁਕਾਵਹਿ ॥
902.e: All the Gopis, the milkmaids, sang in his praises and bowed their heads.

902.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸ︀ਯੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
ਤਨ ਮਨ ਦੇਤ ਅਪਨੋ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
902.e: In their minds, love descended and they willed to sacrifice upon him, both body and soul.(2)

902.g: ਰਾਧਾ ਨਾਮ ਗੋਪਿ ਇਕ ਰਹੈ ॥
ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ॥
902.e: There was one Gopi, named Radha, who meditated pronouncing ‘Krishna, Krishna.’

902.g: ਜਗਨਾਯਕ ਸੌ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਗਾਯੋ ॥
ਸੂਤ ਸਿਧਨ ਕੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਢਾਯੋ ॥੩॥
902.e: She fell in love with Krishna and expanded the string of her love like anaustere.(3)

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
902.e: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

902.g: ਸਾਧੋ; ਕਉਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
902.e: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,

902.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.e: by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ. ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
902.e: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.

902.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ; ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
902.e: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state of Nirvaanaa? ||1||

902.g: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
902.e: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.

902.g: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
902.e: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religious rituals. ||2||

902.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
902.e: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant

902.g: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ. ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ; ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
902.e: - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2||

902.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
902.e: Chaupaee

902.g: ਬਨਿਯੋ ਹੇਤ ਬਨਿਜ ਕੋ ਗਯੋ ॥
ਮੈਨ ਦੁਖ︀ਯ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕੋ ਅਤਿ ਦਯੋ ॥
902.e: The Shah once went out on a business and the wife became very distressed with the urge of sex.

902.g: ਤਿਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
ਕੇਲ ਕਿਯੋ ਇਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
902.e: She could not control herself and called in a man for love-making.

902.g: ਕੇਲ ਕਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਰਹਿ ਗਯੋ ॥
ਕੀਨੇ ਜਤਨ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹਿ ਭਯੋ ॥
902.e: With sex-play she became pregnant and, in spite of hard efforts she could not abort.

902.g: ਨਵ ਮਾਸਨ ਪਾਛੇ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਯੋ ॥
ਤਵਨਹਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਬਨਿਕ ਘਰ ਆਯੋ ॥੩॥
902.e: After nine months a son was born, and that day the Shah came back as well.(3)

902.g: ਬਨਿਕ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਾਯੋ ॥
ਕਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਤੈ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਕਮਾਯੋ ॥
902.e: The Shah, in right fury, asked, ‘Oh, woman you have indulged in debauchery.

902.g: ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
ਬਾਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
902.e: ‘Without making-love a son cannot be born, as all the young and old know this.’(4)

902.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਹੁ, ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਊ ॥
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਾਊ ॥
902.e: ‘Listen, my Shah, I will tell you the story and it will eradicate all the doubts from your heart.

902.g: ਇਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਯੋ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੁਤ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੫॥
902.e: ‘A yogi came in our house in your absence, and due to his benevolence this son is born.’(5)

902.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
902.e: Savaiyya

902.g: ਜੋਬਨ ਜੇਬ ਜਗੇ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ; ਜਾਤ ਜਰਾਵ ਜੁਰੀ ਕਹ ਨਾਤੈ ॥
902.e: His profile was exquisite, and his body was adorned with ornaments.

902.g: ਅੰਗ ਹੁਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਜ ਲੋਗ ਸਭੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਬਨਾਇ ਕਹੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤੈ ॥
902.e: In the courtyard, all had gathered, when Krishna uttered something,

902.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
902.e: Dohira

902.g: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨੰਦ ਕੇ; ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਲਯੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
902.e: In Brindaban, in the house of Nand, Krishna manifested,

902.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ; ਨਿਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਤ ਜੁਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
902.e: And all the three regions sprung up to pay their obeisance.(I)

903.e: Chaupaee
Then the Yogi jovially articulated,
‘Listen to me, my sovereign,
‘The one who comprehends the yoga,

903.g: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧੫॥
903.e: Is a yogi and without Satnam recognises none else.(15)
Dohira

903.g: ਨੈਨਨ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਕਹਿ; ਭੌਹਨ ਉਤਰ ਦੀਨ ॥
903.e: With the glitter through his eyes, Krishna responded,

903.g: ਭੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ਕੌਨਹੂੰ; ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਰ ਦੀਨ ॥੭॥
903.e: But no body acquiesced the mystery and Krishna was bid good-bye.(7)(1)

903.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਅਸੀਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੮੦॥੧੩੪੪॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
903.e: Eightieth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (80)(1342)
Chaupaee

903.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਪੋਖਕ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ॥
903.e: God prevails all over and he is provider of all.
He is benevolent to all and showers all with His grace.(5)
Chaupaee

903.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਧੰਨ੍ਰਯਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਲਾਜ ਤੇ ਪ︀ਯਾਰੀ ॥
903.e: Drig Daniya was his wife; she was much liked by the Raja.
Once Raja came home and he called Yogi Rang Nath.(2)
Dohira

903.g: ਜਬ ਚਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਆਤਮਾ; ਇਕ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
903.e: ‘The soul, whenever it desires, becomes many fold,

903.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਪਸਰਤ ਜਗਤ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਏਕ ॥੧੬॥
903.e: ‘But after roaming around the temporal world, amalgamates with One again.’(16)
Chaupaee
If one side is shrivelled by Him,
The other side is dampened.
If one is terminated by Him, then the other is bestowed with life.
If one aspect diminishes, the other, He enhances. Thus the Creator displays His phenomenon.(7)

903.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
903.e: He is without any boundaries and vignettes.

903.g: ਭੇਖ ਅਭੇਖ ਸਭ ਕੇ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
903.e: He prevails both in the visible and the imperceptible.

903.g: ਜਾ ਪਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਚਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
903.e: Whom-so-ever He takes under his sanctuary,

903.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੌਨ ਛਾਹ ਕੌ ਛੇਰੈ ॥੮॥
903.e: He cannot be blemished by any evil.(8)
He created Jachh, Bhujang in the heaven and
Initiated struggle in between the gods and the demons.
After instituting the earth, the water and five elements,
He postured there to observe His play.(9)
Chaupaee
Is Yoga hypocrisy or is it a life force?

903.g: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧੩॥
903.e: The Yogi who wants to perceive yoga, would not discern without Satnam, the True Name.(13)
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
You preach to the world, and set up your house.
Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?
You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.
You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||

903.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
903.e: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.

903.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ; ਲਾਜ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.e: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||
You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.
How will the burning pain within be relieved?

903.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
903.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,
and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||
You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.
Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.
Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.
Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||
You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.
You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.
You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.
You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||
You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.
You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.
The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.
Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||
You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.
But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.
You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.
You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||
The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.
Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.
One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||

903.g: ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ; ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
903.e: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.
You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.
One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness
- O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2||
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.
Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deep within.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind is attuned to it.
Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||
O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.

903.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.e: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.

903.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ. ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ; ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ. ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.e: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||

903.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ. ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ; ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
903.e: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robed Qazi is the judge.

903.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ; ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
903.e: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord's Praises are good deeds. ||5||

903.g: ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ. ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ. ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
903.e: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacred thread without chastity - what good are these?

903.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ; ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
903.e: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||
In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.
The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.
O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.
Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||

903.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
903.e: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. There is no action higher than this.

903.g: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ. ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
903.e: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should be chastised. ||8||1||
Dohira

903.g: ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਪੋਖਈ; ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੌ ਦੇਇ ॥
903.e: He is the nurture of all and he sustains all.

903.g: ਜੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਫੇਰਈ; ਮਾਗਿ ਮੀਚ ਕਹ ਲੇਇ ॥੬॥
903.e: Who-so-ever turns his mind away from Him, invites his own annihilation.(6)
Dohira

903.g: ਨਗਰ ਸਿਰੋਮਨਿ ਕੋ ਹੁਤੋ; ਸਿੰਘ ਸਿਰੋਮਨਿ ਭੂਪ ॥
903.e: In the city of Siroman, there was one Raja called Siroman Singh.

903.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਦਰਬੁ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਧਰੇ; ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਸਰੂਪ ॥੧॥
903.e: He was as handsome as Cupid and had lot of wealth.(l)
Chaupaee

903.g: ਯਹ ਸਭ ਭੇਦ ਸਾਧੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥

903.e: Only a saint can recognise this fact and there are not many who acknowledge Satnam, the True Name.

903.g: ਜੋ ਸਾਧਕ ਯਾ ਕੌ ਲਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥

903.e: And one who perceives, comes not again to suffer in pregnancy. (11)
Dohira

903.g: ਜਬ ਜੋਗੀ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਤਬ ਰਾਜੈ ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ॥
903.e: When the Yogi had uttered all this, the Raja smiled,

903.g: ਤਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬਾਦਿ ਕੌ; ਉਚਰਤ ਭਯੋ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
903.e: And commenced to explain the essence of Brahma, the Creator.(12)
Dohira

903.g: ਜੀਵ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੈ; ਪੰਥ ਬਨਾਏ ਦੋਇ ॥
903.e: Established all the animation and then formulated two ways (birth and death).

903.g: ਝਗਰਿ ਪਚਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਹਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
903.e: And then lamented, ‘They all get entangled in bickering and none remembers me.’(10)
Chaupaee

903.g: ਯਹ ਨਹਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
903.e: ‘Neither it perishes, nor it annihilates the others,
Only the ignorant remains in vagaries.
‘He knows all and every body’s enigma,

903.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧੭॥
903.e: Because He abides in each and every one.(17)

903.g: ਹਾਥ ਉਚਾਇ ਹਨੀ ਛਤਿਯਾ; ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ਲਜਾਇ ਸਖੀ ਚਹੂੰ ਘਾਤੈ ॥
903.e: Replacing their hands over their chests, the maids smiled in modesty.

903.g: ਨੈਨਨ ਸੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਏ ਜਦੁਨਾਥ ਸੁ; ਭੌਹਨ ਸੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ, ਜਾਹੁ ਇਹਾ ਤੈ ॥੬॥
903.e: Through twinkling eyes, they asked, ‘Oh, Krishna, you go from here.’(6)
Dohira

903.g: ਡਿੰਭ ਦਿਖਾਯੋ ਜਗਤ ਕੋ; ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਯੋ ਜੀਯ ॥
903.e: By displaying hypocrisy to the world, Yoga cannot be attained.

903.g: ਯਾ ਜਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਗਯੋ; ਜਨਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗੇ ਕੀਯ ॥੧੪॥
903.e: Rather the auspicious birth is wasted and the worldly bliss is gained not.(14)
Dohira

903.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਦ ਤਾ ਸੌ ਕਿਯੋ; ਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
903.e: Raja called him and he had conversation with him regarding the Godly attainment.

903.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨ ਸੌ ਭਈ; ਸੋ ਮੈ ਕਹਤ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
903.e: What ever transpired in the discourse, I am going to narrate it to you;(3)

903.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਥ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਬ︀ਯਾਪਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ॥
903.e: Only One is there in the Universe, who is omnipresent.

903.g: ਸਭ ਜੋਨਿਨ ਮੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ; ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ॥੪॥
903.e: He prevails in every life without discrimination of high and low.(4)

904.e: Dohira

904.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਤਯੋ ਹੀ ਕਿਯੋ; ਜੁਗਿਯਹਿ ਲਯੋ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
904.e: The Rani acted accordingly and called the Yogi at home.

904.g: ਲੌਨ ਡਾਰਿ ਭੂਅ ਖੋਦਿ ਕੈ; ਗਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਦਯੋ ਦਬਾਇ ॥੨੯॥
904.e: She caught him, smeared salt on him and buried him in the ground.(29)
Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.
Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||
The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict

904.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
904.e: one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.
The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.
The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||
Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.
Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.
Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,
one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep within himself. ||4||
In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.
With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.

904.g: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ; ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
904.e: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.
I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||
As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.
Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.
The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.
Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||
The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.
The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.
When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.
The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||
My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;
renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.
When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,
O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3||
Chaupaee
Then she approached Raja and told, ‘The Yogi has died,
Kabit

904.g: ਘੋਰਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਯੋ, ਕਹੂੰ ਹਾਥੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਗਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ; ਪੰਛੀ ਰੂਪ ਲਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ, ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
904.e: ‘Sometimes He manifests in horses, sometimes in elephants, and sometimes in cows, ‘Sometimes He is there in birds and sometimes in flora,

904.g: ਪਾਵਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਦਹਿਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ, ਪੌਨ ਰੂਪ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ; ਚੀਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਗਹਿਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ, ਪਾਨੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਬਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
904.e: ‘He burns in the shape of fire and then comes over as air, ‘Sometimes he dwells in the minds and sometimes flows in the shape of water.

904.g: ਅੰਬਰ ਉਤਾਰੇ, ਰਾਵਨਾਦਿਕ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ; ਬਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਹਾਰੇ, ਐਸੇ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
904.e: ‘Sometimes comes down from heaven to annihilate Rawana (devil), ‘In the jungles, which is described in Vedas too.

904.g: ਪੁਰਖ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਕਹੂੰ, ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਧਰਿਯੋ; ਮੂਰਖਨ ਭੇਦ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨੈਕ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਲਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੧੮॥
904.e: ‘Somewhere He is a man and somewhere He takes the shape of woman. ‘Only the fools cannot perceive his mysteries.(18)
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand
that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

904.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
904.e: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.
When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God's Command. ||1||

904.g: ਝੂਠੁ. ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ; ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
904.e: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.

904.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
904.e: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||
Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.
He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.
Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.

904.g: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ; ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
904.e: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||
You bathe, wash, and worship stones.
But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.
Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.
The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||
You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.
You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?

904.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
904.e: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.
When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||
Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.

904.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
904.e: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.
I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.
The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||

904.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
904.e: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.
Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.
Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.

904.g: ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
904.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||
Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.
Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
Dohira

904.g: ਐਸੇ ਬਚਨਨ ਸੁਨਤ ਹੀ; ਰਾਜਾ ਭਯੋ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
904.e: Listening to such exposition, Raja became depressed,

904.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਰਬੁ ਘਰ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ; ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਭਯੋ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥੨੪॥
904.e: And was dejected with the temporal life, home, wealth, and sovereignty.(24)

904.g: ਜਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਸੁਨਿਯੋ; ਦੁਖਤ ਭਈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥
904.e: When the Rani heard all this, she felt afflicted,

904.g: ਦੇਸ ਦਰਬੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਜਾਤ ਲਖਿਯੋ ਨਰ ਨਾਹ ॥੨੫॥
904.e: As she learnt that Raja was going away leaving the kingdom, wealth and the home.(25)

904.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਲਯੋ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
904.e: When Rani was in extreme distress; she called in the Minister.

904.g: ਕ︀ਯੋਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਖਿਯੈ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
904.e: She asked him to suggest her some resolve so that Raja could be kept at home.(26)
Chaupaee

904.g: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਿਯ ਲਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਿਕਟ ਨਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
904.e: ‘Those who recognise Satnam, the angel of death comes not near them,

904.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰਹਿ ਹੈ ॥
ਬਨ ਗਿਰ ਪੁਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਭ ਢਹਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
904.e: ‘And without his Name all the jungles, mountains, mansions, and towns face destruction.(21)
Chaupaee
Then the minister suggested like this, ‘Rani, listen to your minister,

904.g: ਐਸੋ ਜਤਨ ਆਜੁ ਹਮ ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਖਿ, ਜੋਗਿਯਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੭॥
904.e: ‘I will, today, proceed in such a way that I will keep the Raja at home and terminate the Yogi.(27)

904.g: ਰਾਨੀ, ਜੋ ਹੌ ਕਹੌ, ਸੁ ਕਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਤੇ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਡਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
904.e: ‘Aye, Rani, you do what I say, and do not be afraid of Raja.
‘You call the Yogi at home, cover him with salt and bury him in the ground.’(28)
Dohira

904.g: ਚਕਿਯਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਟ ਬਨੇ; ਗਗਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
904.e: ‘The sky and the earth are like two grinding stones.

904.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਪੁਰਨ ਮੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ; ਸਾਬਿਤ ਗਯਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨੨॥
904.e: ‘Coming any thing in between is saved not.(22)
Dohira

904.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਪੇ; ਬਾਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਇ ॥
904.e: ‘The old and the young, all should meditate on him,

904.g: ਰਾਵ ਰੰਕ ਰਾਜਾ, ਸਭੈ; ਜਿਯਤ ਨ ਰਹਸੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੨੦॥
904.e: ‘(Without his name) the rulers or the subject, nothing will remain.(20)
Chaupaee
‘Those who accept Satnam, Satnam prevails in their eloquence.

904.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਦਲਹੀ ॥੨੩॥
904.e: ‘They proceed on the way of Satnam and the demons of death do not trouble them.’(23)
Chaupaee

904.g: ਕਵਨ ਮਰੈ, ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਰੈ ॥

904.e: ‘Whom does He kill and why, the innocent people cannot grasp.

904.g: ਯਹ ਨ ਮਰਤ, ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥

904.e: ‘Neither He kills nor he dies, and you try to acquiesce this, Oh Raja.(19)

905.e: Chaupaee
‘When a human being is born, he loses his childhood at the birth.

905.g: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਤੁ ਕੋ ਚੀਨੋ ॥੪੨॥
905.e: ‘During youth, he indulges in merry-makings and never tries to realise his roots.( 42)
Dohira

905.g: ਸੁਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਤਰੁਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤੈ ਤ︀ਯਾਗਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਜ ॥
905.e: ‘You are leaving behind your offspring, son, and youthful wife,

905.g: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਯੋ ਕਸੂਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਰਾਜ ॥੩੪॥
905.e: ‘You tell me, how your rule could continue.(34)

905.g: ਪੂਤ ਪਰੇ ਲੋਟਤ ਧਰਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
905.e: Offspring are rolling around on the ground, wife is crying,

905.g: ਬੰਧੁ ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੋਦਨ ਕਰੈ; ਰਾਜ ਬੰਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੫॥
905.e: ‘The servants and the relatives are weeping, who will now rule over?’(35)
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.

905.g: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
905.e: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

905.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

905.g: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ. ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ; ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
905.e: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.
In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.
Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||
The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.
He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
905.e: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||

905.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ; ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?
The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?
One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||
With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.

905.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ; ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?

905.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ; ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
905.e: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||

905.g: ਅੰਨੁ. ਨ ਖਾਹਿ; ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.

905.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.
The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||
Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.

905.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ; ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
905.e: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
905.e: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||
Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.
Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.

905.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
905.e: O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5||
Dohira

905.g: ਕੋ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤਾ, ਪਾਚ ਤਤ ਕੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
905.e: ‘What are mother, wife, and offspring? They are just the embodiment

905.g: ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਪੇਖਨੋ; ਅੰਤ ਖੇਹ ਕੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥
905.e: Of five elements, which at the end are bound to parish.(41)
Dohira

905.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੇਸ ਦੈ; ਕਬ ਹੀ ਲਿਯੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਥ ॥
905.e: ‘Raja must be coming wearing the garb of yogi and accompanying the Nath Yogi.’

905.g: ਯੌ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਨੈ ਨਹੀ; ਕਹਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਹ ਸਾਥ ॥੩੭॥
905.e: But the fools did not know what had happened to the Yogi.(37)

905.g: ਸੁਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਤਰੁਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਛਾਡਤ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
905.e: The offspring, sons, young ladies and maid, all were begging Raja not to leave.

905.g: ਚੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰੋਦਨ ਕਰੈ; ਦਯਾ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
905.e: They all were crying and asking, ‘Why are you leaving us. Don’t you take pity on us?’(38)

905.g: ਸੁਨੁ ਰਾਨੀ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਕੋ ਭੇਦ ॥
905.e: (Raja replied) ‘Listen, you the Ranis,

905.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਹਤ; ਔਰ ਉਚਾਰਤ ਬੇਦ ॥੩੯॥
905.e: I will tell you through the wisdom of Vedas.(39)
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.

905.g: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
905.e: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.
He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.
Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||
Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.

905.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ, ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
905.e: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.
That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.
The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||

905.g: ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ; ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
905.e: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.
Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.
Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?
The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.
Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people,

905.g: ਸੋ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਯ ਮਹਿ ਗਹਿਯੋ ॥੩੦॥
905.e: ‘Whatever he pronounced at the time of his death, I am determined to carry on.(30)

905.g: ਤੁਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਰਹਿਯਹੁ ॥
905.e: ‘He told me to tell Raja that to stay at home,

905.g: ਇਨ ਰਾਨਿਨ ਕੌ ਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਦੀਜਹੁ ॥

905.e: ‘Not to keep the Ranis in adversity and not to abandon the kingship.(31)

905.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਇਕ ਬਚਨ ਉਚਾਰੋ ॥
ਜੌ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਹਾਰੋ ॥
905.e: ‘Then he told me that, if Raja refused to obey”

905.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਤਪ ਕਹ ਹਰਿਯਹੁ ॥੩੨॥
905.e: ‘Then, I should make clear to him that all the benefits of his meditation will be revoked.’(32)

905.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਹੀ ਸੁ ਪਾਛੇ ਕਹਿ ਹੌ ॥
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਸਕਲ ਭਰਮ ਕੋ ਦਹਿ ਹੌ ॥
905.e: ‘What else he told me, I will convey to you later on. First I will eradicate all your whims.

905.g: ਅਬ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੈ ਤੈ ਬਚਨ ਹਮਾਰੋ ॥
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਜ ਤਿਹਾਰੋ ॥੩੩॥
905.e: ‘Now, if you acted upon what I communicated to you, your rule will continue.(33)
One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,
is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||
One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.
Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:
rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.
His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||
Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,
possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.
One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,
O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4||
Chaupaee
(On the other side) The disciples were getting very happy, and the weaklings were getting plump.

905.g: ਨਾਥ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਯੈ ਹੌ ॥
ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਕੇ ਟੂਕ ਮੰਗੈ ਹੈ ॥੩੬॥
905.e: (They were thinking) ‘Yogi, soon, will bring Raja along and send him for begging food from door to door.(36)
Dohira

905.g: ਬਿਰਧ ਭਏ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਪਈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
905.e: ‘When he gets old, his body starts shaking as he had not meditated on the Name,

905.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਭਜਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੇ; ਪਾਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਤ ਤਨ ਆਇ ॥੪੩॥
905.e: ‘And, being lacking the Godly prayer, the vices over powers him.(43)

905.g: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਮੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ; ਬਾਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਇ ॥
905.e: ‘Reaching the domain of death, neither the sons, nor the old, the
Chaupaee
‘Mother is jovially making the child to play but the death is over shadowing.

905.g: ਵੁਹ ਨਿਤ ਲਖੇ ਪੂਤ ਬਢਿ ਜਾਵਤ ॥

905.e: ‘She is happy to see the child growing but she does not envisage the death coming nearer and nearer.(40)

906.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮਸਿ; ਬਿਆਧਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
906.e: and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

906.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
906.e: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||

906.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ; ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ. ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
906.e: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.

906.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ; ਨਰਕੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
906.e: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.

906.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੋ; ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
906.e: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
906.e: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||

906.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
906.e: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods

906.g: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ; ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹਿ ਭੇਵਾ ॥
906.e: cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

906.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ; ਗਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
906.e: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru

906.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
906.e: - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

906.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
906.e: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.

906.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ; ਰਹਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥
906.e: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.

906.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ; ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ॥
906.e: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.

906.g: ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
906.e: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||

906.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ; ਮਨ ਭੀਨੈ ॥
906.e: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.

906.g: ਝੂਠਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ; ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ॥
906.e: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ; ਨਹੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
906.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.

906.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
906.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6||

906.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
906.e: Chaupaee

906.g: ਦੁਤਿਯ ਬਚਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋ ਕਹਿਯੋ ॥
ਸੋ ਮੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਗਹਿਯੋ ॥
906.e: ‘What the other things Yogi said, I had kept in my heart,

906.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹੌ, ਸੁ ਬਚਨ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
ਤੁਮ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਿਯ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੫੪॥
906.e: ‘I will tell you but only if you appraise it truthfully.(54)

906.g: ਮੰਦਰ ਏਕ ਉਜਾਰ ਉਸਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
ਬੈਠੇ ਤਹਾ ਤਪਸ︀ਯਾ ਕਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
906.e: “In the wilderness, build up a temple, sitting where you do the

906.g: ਹੌ ਤਹ ਔਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਧਰ ਐਹੋ ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੋ ਸਮੁਝੈਹੋ ॥੫੫॥
906.e: Meditation. “Keeping an idol there, impart the celestial knowledge to the Raja.”(55)

906.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
906.e: Chhand

906.g: ਛੰਦ ॥
906.e: Raja’s Talk

906.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਯੌ ਕਹੀ; ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨ ਮੇਰੋ, ਰਾਨੀ ॥
906.e: Raja spoke again, ‘Listen to me, Rani,

906.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਕਛੂ ਤੈ ਨੈਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
906.e: ‘You have not understood an iota of the celestial cognisance,

906.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਾਪੁਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ; ਨੇਹ ਜਾ ਸੌ ਅਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
906.e: ‘What is the criteria of a woman who is loved so much?

906.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਧਾਮ; ਬਿਹਸਿ ਆਗੇ ਤਿਹ ਧਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੫੨॥
906.e: ‘Yes, just this that she presents the urinary place.’(52)

906.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
906.e: Dohira

906.g: ਅਤਿ ਚਾਤੁਰਿ ਰਾਨੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ; ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
906.e: The wise Rani talked very sensibly,

906.g: ਰੋਗੀ ਕੇ ਪਥ ਜ︀ਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਭਯੋ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੫੧॥
906.e: But like the preventions detailed to a sick-man, Raja did not concede to any.(51)

906.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
906.e: Rani’s Talk

906.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਯਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਯਾਹੀ ਉਪਜਾਏ ॥
906.e: Rajas and sages were born through her,

906.g: ਬ੍ਰਯਾਸਾਦਿਕ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰ; ਇਹੀ ਮਾਰਗ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਆਏ ॥
906.e: Sage Viyas and the other wise men had all passed through this course.

906.g: ਪਰਸੇ ਯਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕਹੋ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਯੋ ॥
906.e: Without her enterprise, how can one come into this world?

906.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਐਤ ਭਵ ਪਾਇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੫੦॥
906.e: Pristinely, only coming through this way, one attained Godly bliss.(50)

906.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
906.e: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

906.g: ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ. ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ; ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ. ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.e: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.

906.g: ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ. ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
906.e: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

906.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ; ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.e: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.

906.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ. ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ; ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ. ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
906.e: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam, and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||

906.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ. ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.e: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within your skeleton has turned to dry wood.

906.g: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
906.e: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||

906.g: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ; ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.e: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life has been ruined.

906.g: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
906.e: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

906.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
906.e: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither the Naam, nor compassion for all.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
906.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Without the Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||

906.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ; ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.e: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled in emotional attachment and sin.

906.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ; ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
906.e: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated with attachment to Maya. ||5||

906.g: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ. ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
906.e: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of the Shabad, you have fallen into confusion.

906.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ. ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
906.e: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||

906.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.e: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.

906.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ. ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
906.e: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||

906.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
906.e: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.

906.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ. ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
906.e: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ||8||

906.g: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ. ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ; ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
906.e: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to the serpent in the terrifying world-ocean.

906.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
906.e: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9||

906.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ; ਜਿਯਤ ਨ ਰਹਸੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੪੪॥
906.e: High, the low, the rulers, the subject, attain emancipation.’(44)

906.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ; ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰੀ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ॥
ਪੋਸਤਿਯਾ ਕੀ ਨੀਦ ਜ︀ਯੋਂ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਸੋਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੪੫॥
ਜੋ ਉਪਜਿਯੋ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਜਗ ਰਹਿਬੋ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
906.e: Listening such talks, Rani became unconscious,

906.g: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਹਾ, ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੪੬॥
906.e: And was over powered by imperturbable sleep.(46)

906.g: ਛੰਦ ॥
906.e: Chhand

906.g: ਪਤਿ ਪੂਤਨ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ; ਬਿਜੈ ਪੂਤਨ ਤੇ ਪੈਯੈ ॥
906.e: (Rani) With the offspring comes the honour in the world.

906.g: ਦਿਰਬੁ ਕਪੂਤਨ ਜਾਇ; ਰਾਜ ਸਪੂਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਰੈਯੈ ॥
906.e: Due to spurious progeny the wealth is lost.

906.g: ਪਿੰਡ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੀ ਦੇਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੂਤੋ ਉਪਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
906.e: The dead are honoured through sons.

906.g: ਬਹੁਤ ਦਿਨਨ ਕੋ ਬੈਰ; ਗਯੋ ਪੂਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
906.e: The age-old enmities are eliminated by dint of the sons.

906.g: ਜੋ ਪੂਤਨ ਕੌ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਤਪਸ︀ਯਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
906.e: The Raja who abandons his offspring and become an ascetic,

906.g: ਪਰੈ ਨਰਕ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ; ਅਧਿਕ ਤਨ ਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੭॥
906.e: He is thrown in the hell and remains in misery.(47)

906.g: ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਪੂਤ; ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
906.e: (Raja) Neither I have any son, nor I have any wife.

906.g: ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਪਿਤਾ; ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
906.e: Neither I have my father, nor any mother.

906.g: ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਭੈਨ; ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਰੋ ਕੋਈ ਭਾਈ ॥
906.e: Neither I have a sister, nor I have any brother.

906.g: ਨ ਕੋ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਦੇਸ; ਨ ਹੌ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੌ ਰਾਈ ॥
906.e: Neither I Own a Country, nor I am the ruler.

906.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਆਇ; ਜੋਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਯੋ ॥
906.e: Without yoga I have obliterated my birth.

906.g: ਤਜ︀ਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਟ ਯਹੈ ਜਿਯਰੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਭਾਯੋ ॥੪੮॥
906.e: To abandon the kingship, would satisfy me most now.(48)

906.g: ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ; ਪੁਰਖ ਬਹੁਤੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
906.e: Then, when he gets access to a urinary place (vagina), he exclaims, ‘I had sex.’

906.g: ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਮ ਕੌ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਤ; ਹਮ ਭੋਗ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
906.e: Man enters the mother’s womb and faces agony.

906.g: ਥੂਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕੌ ਚਾਟਿ; ਕਹਤ ਅਧਰਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
906.e: He licks the spit from woman’s lips and thinks he is honoured with nectar.

906.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਜਨਮੁ; ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗਵਾਯੋ ॥੪੯॥
906.e: But he does not reflect that he has lost the worth of his birth.(49)

906.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
906.e: Dohira

906.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਸੁਨੁ ਹੋ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
906.e: Then Raja further added, Listen, Oh the princess,

906.g: ਜੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਸੋ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਹੌ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੫੩॥
906.e: Whatever Yogi has told you, you reveal it to me.’(53)

907.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
907.e: Savaiyya

907.g: ਹੈ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਿਬੋ ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਕਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਤੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਯੋਂ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
907.e: ‘’Aye, Pretty Woman, to live in the jungle is very wearisome, how would you tolerate?

907.g: ਸੀਤ ਤੁਸਾਰ ਪਰੈ ਤਨ ਪੈ; ਸੁ ਇਤੋ ਤਬ ਤੌ ਹਠਹੂੰ ਨ ਗਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
907.e: “There you will have to bear on your body all sort of cold and heat, how would you survive that?

907.g: ਸਾਲ ਤਮਾਲ ਬਡੇ ਜਹ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਲ; ਨਿਹਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਹੁਧਾ ਬਿਲਲੈ ਹੈ ॥
907.e: “There exist the reptiles as big as the trees, looking at them, you will cry,

907.g: ਤੂ ਸੁਕਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ; ਸੁ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ, ਤੁਹਿ ਕੌਨ ਉਠੈ ਹੈ ॥੬੪॥
907.e: “There prevails extreme drought, if you ever fell down, who will help you to get up.”(64)

907.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
907.e: Chaupaee

907.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਈ ॥
ਲੀਨੇ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਕੰਥਾ ਕਰਵਾਈ ॥
907.e: Then the Rani came to the Raja and got two coffins prepared.

907.g: ਇਕ ਤੁਮ ਧਰੋ ਏਕ ਹੌ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਸੰਗ ਤਪਸ︀ਯਾ ਕਰਿਹੋ ॥੬੨॥
907.e: ‘You wear one and other I will. I will go in for meditation with you.’(62)

907.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
907.e: Dohira

907.g: ਬਾਨੀ ਤਹਾ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ; ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ਤੁਮੈ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
907.e: “Then, there will descend the celestial renderings,

907.g: ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਸਤਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਯੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਹੁਚ︀ਯੋ ਆਇ ॥੫੬॥
907.e: “Through which you will acknowledge the God-seeking Yogi.”(56)

907.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
907.e: Chaupaee

907.g: ਤਾ ਸੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਹਿ ਸਮੁਝੈਯਹੁ ॥
ਤੁਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਠਹਿਰੈਯਹੁ ॥
907.e: She told him, ‘Acting like a yogi, you make Raja to understand,

907.g: ਕ︀ਯੋ ਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਹਿ ਮੋਰਿ ਘਰ ਲ︀ਯਾਵਹੁ ॥
ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਗਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੬੦॥
907.e: ‘And bring him round to come home and you will get whatever you desire.’(60)

907.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
907.e: Rani’s Talk

907.g: ਸੀਤ ਸਮੀਰ ਸਹੌ ਤਨ ਪੈ; ਸੁਨੁ ਨਾਥ, ਤੁਮੈ ਅਬ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
907.e: ‘Listen my master, I will bear the cold winds on my body but will not leave you,

907.g: ਸਾਲ ਤਮਾਲ ਬਡੇ ਜਹ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਲ; ਨਿਹਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਡਰ ਪੈਹੋ ॥
907.e: ‘Seeing the reptiles as tall as trees, I will be dreaded.

907.g: ਰਾਜ ਤਜੋ, ਸਜ ਸਾਜ ਤਪੋ ਧਨ; ਲਾਜ ਧਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਧੈਹੋ ॥
907.e: ‘Abandoning the reigning, and the wealth I will accompany you to gain contemplation.

907.g: ਬਾਤ ਇਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਗਾਤ ਸਹੋ; ਬਨ ਨਾਯਕ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਪਾਤ ਚਬੈਹੋ ॥੬੫॥
907.e: ‘I won’t hesitate to bear all the miseries, and, even, would live on the leaves.’(65)

907.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
907.e: Dohira

907.g: ਜਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਤਬ ਰਾਜੈ ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ॥
907.e: When Rani said so, Raja smiled and asked,

907.g: ਜੋ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਰੀ; ਸੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਹੋ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੬੩॥
907.e: ‘Whatever he had talked, you let me know.’(63)

907.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
907.e: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

907.g: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ; ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ, ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
907.e: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

907.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
907.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

907.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
907.e: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

907.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ. ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
907.e: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

907.g: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
907.e: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

907.g: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ, ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
907.e: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

907.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ. ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
907.e: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

907.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ, ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ; ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
907.e: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

907.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ; ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
907.e: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

907.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ; ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
907.e: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

907.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ; ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
907.e: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

907.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ; ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
907.e: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||

907.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
907.e: Raja’s Talk

907.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
907.e: Dohira

907.g: ਰਾਜ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧ ਰਾਖਿਯਹੁ; ਨਾਥ ਸੰਭਰਿਯਹੁ ਨਿਤ ॥
907.e: ‘You better look after the dominion and remember your master every

907.g: ਸੁਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਕੀਜਿਯਹੁ; ਬਚਨ ਧਾਰਿਯਹੁ ਚਿਤ ॥੬੬॥
907.e: Day, ‘Complying with my entreaty, you look after your sons.’(66)

907.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
907.e: Dohira

907.g: ਜਬ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਐਸੋ ਬਚਨ; ਰਾਨੀ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
907.e: When Rani had called him and asked him to talk like that,

907.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਗੇ ਹੁਤੋ; ਸਕਲ ਭੇਦ ਗਯੋ ਪਾਇ ॥੬੧॥
907.e: He, being a clever man, comprehended all the secret.(61)

907.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
907.e: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehl:

907.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
907.e: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

907.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
907.e: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

907.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
907.e: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

907.g: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ. ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ; ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
907.e: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

907.g: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
907.e: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

907.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ. ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ; ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
907.e: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

907.g: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ. ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ; ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
907.e: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

907.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
907.e: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

907.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
907.e: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

907.g: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
907.e: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

907.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
907.e: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

907.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
907.e: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

907.g: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ; ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
907.e: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

907.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
907.e: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

907.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
907.e: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

907.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
907.e: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

907.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ; ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
907.e: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

907.g: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
907.e: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

907.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
907.e: Savaiyya

907.g: ਰਾਜ ਤਜੋ, ਸਜਿ ਸਾਜ ਤਪੋ ਧਨ; ਕਾਜ ਨ ਬਾਸਵ ਕੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ॥
907.e: ‘I am relinquishing the governance and by leaving all this I do not even fancy the god Indra’s domain.

907.g: ਅਸ੍ਵ ਪਦਾਤੁ ਬਨੈ ਬਨ ਬਾਰੁਣ; ਚਾਹਤ ਹੌ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾਈ ॥
907.e: ‘The horses, elephants, and foot soldiers, which are trustworthy, I do not conceive.

907.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
907.e: Dohira

907.g: ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੁਤੋ; ਨਾਮ ਸਿੰਘ ਆਨੂਪ ॥
907.e: She had a servant named Anoop Singh,

907.g: ਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਿਯਾ ਕੀ ਬੈਸ ਥੋ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਕਲ ਸਰੂਪ ॥੫੯॥
907.e: In his profile he looked as if he was in the guise of Yogi.(59)

907.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
907.e: Chaupaee

907.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਸਦਨ ਸਵਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
ਛਾਤ ਬੀਚ ਰੌਜਨ ਇਕ ਧਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
907.e: Rani built a mansion in the jungle and constructed an alcove in there,

907.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੇ ਮਨੁਖ ਛਪਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
ਜੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਕਹੈ ॥੫੭॥
907.e: Behind which a man could hide and where he could do whatever he liked.(57)

907.g: ਬੈਠੇ ਤਰੇ ਨਜਰਿ ਨਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਬਾਨੀ ਨਭ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਲਖਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
907.e: The person sitting beneath could not see him and his voice would seem as an articulation from heaven.

907.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਤਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੈਠਾਯੋ ॥
ਅਮਿਤ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਿਖਾਯੋ ॥੫੮॥
907.e: Rani asked a man to sit in there, and, with the incentive of lot of wealth, she trained him.(58)

908.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
908.e: Dohira

908.g: ਬਿਦਾ ਦੀਜਿਯੈ ਦਾਸ ਕੌ; ਬਨ ਕੌ ਕਰੈ ਪਯਾਨ ॥
908.e: ‘Please bid me farewell, to enable me to go to the jungle,

908.g: ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਾਨਨ ਧ︀ਯਾਇ ਹੌ ਜੌ ਭਵ ਕੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੭੪॥
908.e: ‘And, contemplating on the Vedas, meditate on the Lord God,’

908.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
908.e: Rani’s Talk

908.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
908.e: Kabit

908.g: ਬਾਲਕਨ ਬੋਰੌ ਰਾਜ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਛੋਰੌ ਔਰ ਭੂਖਨਨ ਤੋਰੋ ਕਠਿਨਾਈ ਐਸੀ ਝਲਿਹੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘I will forsake the children and cast off (god) Indra’s Domain. ‘I will break all my ornaments, and get ready to face all sorts of inconveniences.

908.g: ਪਾਤ ਫਲ ਖੈਹੌ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੈਹੌ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ︀ਯਾਰੇ ਕੇ ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਮੈ ਗਲਿਹੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘I will live on leaves and wild fruits, and fight with the reptiles and the lions.

908.g: ਜੌਨ ਹੌ ਸੁ ਹੈਹੌ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖੌ ਪਾਛੇ ਚਲੀ ਜੈਹੌ ਨਾ ਤੌ ਬਿਰਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ਬੀਚ ਬਲਿ ਹੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘And without my beloved master, I will rot in Himalayan colds. ‘Come what may be, but, imbued in your vision, I will follow you.

908.g: ਕੌਨ ਕਾਜ ਰਾਜਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਸਾਜ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਬਿਨ ਨਾਥ ਜੂ ਤਿਹਾਰੋ ਰਹੇ ਰਹੌਂ ਚਲੇ ਚਲਿਹੌਂ ॥੬੯॥
908.e: ‘Failing which I will scorch myself in the fire of isolation. ‘Oh, my master, without you what good is this reign. ‘If, My Master, you go, I will depart to.(69)

908.g: ਅੜਿਲ ॥
908.e: Arril

908.g: ਜਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਲਖੀ; ਸਤਿ ਜੋਗਿਨਿ ਭਈ ॥
908.e: When the Raja found that Rani had really become a yogin,

908.g: ਛੋਰਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਧਾਮ; ਸੰਗ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਲਈ ॥
908.e: He decided to leave the home along with her.

908.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ਭੇਸ; ਮਾਤ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਯੋ ॥
908.e: In ascetic’s garb he came to see his mother.

908.g: ਹੋ ਭੇਸ ਜੋਗ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਹੇਰਿ; ਸਭਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇਯੋ ॥੭੩॥
908.e: Everybody was astonished to see him dressed as a yogi.(73)

908.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
908.e: Savaiyya

908.g: ਦੇਸ ਤਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਸ ਤਪੋ ਧਨ ਕੇਸ ਮਰੋਰਿ ਜਟਾਨਿ ਸਵਾਰੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘I will relinquish my country, and, with mated hair, become a yogin (female ascetic).

908.g: ਲੇਸ ਕਰੌ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਧਨ ਕੌ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪਨਿਯਾ ਪਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਤਨ ਵਾਰੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘I have no monetary affections and would sacrifice my life on for the sake of your shoes.

908.g: ਬਾਲਕ ਕ੍ਰੋਰਿ ਕਰੌ ਇਕ ਓਰ ਸੁ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਛੋਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਭਾਰੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘Renouncing all my children and the fancy living, I will put my mind in the meditation of God.

908.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਸਭੈ ਘਰ ਜਾਰੌਂ ॥੭੦॥
908.e: ‘I have nothing to do, even, with god Indra and, without my lord, ‘I will put my dwellings on fire.(70)

908.g: ਅੰਗਨ ਮੈ ਸਜਿਹੌ ਭਗਵੈ ਪਟ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਖੈ ਚਿਪਿਯਾ ਗਹਿ ਲੈਹੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘Adoring the saffron clothes (of an ascetic), I will take a beggingbowl in my hands.

908.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਨ ਕਾਨ ਧਰੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਤਵ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਿਛਹਿ ਮਾਗਿ ਅਘੈਹੌਂ ॥
908.e: ‘With (yogic) ear-rings, I will be contended with begging for your sake.

908.g: ਨਾਥ ਚਲੌ ਤੁਮ ਠੌਰ ਜਹਾ ਹਮਹੂੰ ਤਿਹ ਠੌਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਚਲਿ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
908.e: ‘Now I stress it to you that I will never remain in the house and,

908.g: ਧਾਮ ਰਹੋ ਨਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਕਹੋ ਪਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਸਭੈ ਅਬ ਜੋਗਿਨ ਹ੍ਵੈਹੌਂ ॥੭੧॥
908.e: Tearing off my clothes, will become a yogin.’(71)

908.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
908.e: Mother’s talk

908.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
908.e: Savaiyya

908.g: ਪੂਤ, ਰਹੌ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਕਛੂ ਦਿਨ; ਪਾਲ ਕਰੌ ਇਨ ਦੇਸਨ ਕੌ ॥
908.e: ‘Oh, my son, the dispenser of comforts, I am sacrifice to You

908.g: ਤੁਹਿ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨ ਕਹੋ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਕੌ ॥
908.e: ‘How can I ask you to go, it puts me in tremendous adversity.

908.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਇਤੋ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ; ਕਹਾ ਕਹਿ ਹੌ ਇਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਕੌ ॥
908.e: ‘When you go away, what would I tell the entire Subject.

908.g: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਪੂਤ, ਕਹੋ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ; ਤੁਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦੇਉ ਬਿਦਾ ਬਨ ਕੌ ॥੭੫॥
908.e: ‘Tell me son, how can I bid you farewell to leave.(75)

908.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
908.e: Raja's Talk

908.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
908.e: Dohira

908.g: ਮਾਤਹਿ ਸੀਸ ਝੁਕਾਇ ਕੈ; ਪੁਨਿ ਬੋਲਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬੈਨ ॥
908.e: Raja had bowed his head before his mother and said,

908.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ; ਜੈ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਐਨ ॥੭੭॥
908.e: ‘The high and the low, and those above the subject, will all go to the domain of death.’(77)

908.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
908.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

908.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
908.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

908.g: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
908.e: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

908.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
908.e: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

908.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
908.e: Play that harp, Yogi,

908.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
908.e: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

908.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
908.e: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

908.g: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ; ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
908.e: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

908.g: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ, ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
908.e: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

908.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ, ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
908.e: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

908.g: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
908.e: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

908.g: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
908.e: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

908.g: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ, ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
908.e: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
908.e: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

908.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ. ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ; ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
908.e: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

908.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ. ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
908.e: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

908.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
908.e: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

908.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
908.e: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||

908.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
908.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

908.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
908.e: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

908.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
908.e: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

908.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
908.e: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

908.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ. ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ; ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
908.e: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ. ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
908.e: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

908.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ; ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
908.e: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

908.g: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ. ਅਉਧੂ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
908.e: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ; ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
908.e: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

908.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
908.e: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

908.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ; ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
908.e: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

908.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ. ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ; ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
908.e: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

908.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ; ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
908.e: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

908.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
908.e: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

908.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚੁ ॥
908.e: Raja's Talk

908.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ; ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਚਿਤ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
908.e: Watching the Rani in such a state, the Raja deliberated and said,

908.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋ ਸੁਖ ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ, ਤੋਹਿ ਤਜੇ ਲਰਕਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
908.e: ‘You rule over with bliss. Without you all the children will die.’

908.g: ਸੋ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ, ਨ ਹਟੈ ਬਨ ਤੇ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਝਾਰਿ ਪਛੋਰਿ ਭਲੇ ਅਵਗਾਹੀ ॥
908.e: The Raja tried to entice her but she did not concede.

908.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ; ਨਾਰਿ ਹਠੀ ਹਠ ਛਾਡਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੭੨॥
908.e: The Raja thought) ‘On one side the mother earth is becoming desperate but the stubborn lady is not surrendering.’(72)

908.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
908.e: Dohira

908.g: ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਬਸਤ ਧਾਮ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
908.e: The wife, who renounces her husband and remains at home,

908.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਆਗੇ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਕੇ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪੈਠਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੬੮॥
908.e: She gets no reception in the heaven hereafter.(68)

908.g: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਰ ਤਜੇ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ; ਤਜੋ ਅਸੁਰਾਰਿ ਯਹੈ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
908.e: ‘I am leaving the boys, the girls and the wife along with all their skirmishes.

908.g: ਜਾਇ ਬਸੋ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋ; ਸੁਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ, ਆਜੁ ਇਹੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੬੭॥
908.e: ‘Listen, the pretty lady, I will go and dwell in the jungle, and attain the bliss, and this I like it very much.’(67)

908.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
908.e: Chaupaee

908.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋ ਸੁਤ ਬਨ ਨ ਪਧਾਰੋ ॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
908.e: ‘Yielding to my request, don’t go to jungle.

908.g: ਲੋਗਨ ਕੇ ਕਹਿਬੋ ਅਨੁਸਰਿਯੈ ॥
ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਘਰਿ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥੭੬॥
908.e: ‘Listen to the people and try to attain yogic domain at home.’(76)

909.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
909.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

909.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
909.e: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru has inspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||

909.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
909.e: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||

909.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ. ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
909.e: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||

909.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
909.e: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||

909.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ. ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
909.e: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will be our only help and support. ||4||

909.g: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ. ਦੂਰਿ, ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
909.e: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||

909.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
909.e: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||6||

909.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ; ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
909.e: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it is obtained. ||7||

909.g: ਭਰਮਿ. ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
909.e: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in one place. ||8||

909.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
909.e: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||

909.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ; ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
909.e: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yoga is not attained. ||10||

909.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
909.e: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall find Yoga. ||11||

909.g: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ. ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
909.e: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

909.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
909.e: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||

909.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
909.e: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people; through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||

909.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ. ਨਾਮੁ, ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
909.e: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam; without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||

909.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
909.e: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost in confusion. ||16||

909.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ; ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
909.e: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||
